body: A toolkit for training, viewing, and exporting neural radiance fields.
plain_description: **Create, train, and test neural 3D scenes with a guided workflow.** Use the web viewer to explore scenes, plan camera paths, and render videos or point clouds. Bring in your own images or video to build a 3D render.
technical_description: Nerfstudio is a modular Python framework for creating, training, and testing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs). It provides training and export commands, data processing for custom captures, and a web-based viewer for visualizing training, interacting with scenes, and rendering camera paths. The README requires an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA for setup.
title: Nerfstudio
